verdict.rationale: UKVI's own pages document a non-resident founder path. The Innovator Founder visa sets an eligibility test (an innovative business "different from anything else on the market"), gives a separate outside-UK fee and application flow, and lets applicants verify identity through the UK Immigration: ID Check app. The pack does not show which foreign documents or identifiers are accepted, and its eligibility detail is thin (no endorsement requirement shown). missing for 10: list of acceptable foreign credentials/identity documents, full eligibility criteria and extra steps for out-of-country founders (e.g. endorsement, biometrics), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages

citations.quote: you want to set up and run an innovative business in the UK - it must be something that’s different from anything else on the market
It costs £1,357 per person if you apply outside the UK.
the Innovator Founder route's application path is stated with separate in-country and out-of-country flows
verify your identity and submit your documents and application online using the UK Immigration: ID Check app
